title: Building a Unified Inline Code Editing Model for GitHub Copilot
abstract: arXiv:2611.33314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-assisted coding ranges from fully agentic coding to inline code suggestions in the editor. Inline suggestions require predicting a developer's most likely next edit from an editing session. The next edit may lie at the cursor, in nearby lines, or farther away, and one editing intent can span several of these. The preceding system queries separate completion, nearby edit, and long-distance edit models, each with its own output format, in a fixed sequence; it thus cannot express intents spanning distant locations in one response, can require several sequential model calls per suggestion, and prioritizes completion even when a correction would serve better. We present a unified model that predicts all three edit types in one output space: a sequence of anchored diff patches specifying locations, deleted lines, and added lines. translated_title: 构建面向GitHub Copilot的统一行内代码编辑模型
translated_abstract: AI辅助编程的范围涵盖从完全智能体式编程到编辑器中的行内代码建议。行内建议需要从编辑会话中预测开发者最可能的下一次编辑。下一次编辑可能位于光标处、邻近行中，或更远的位置，而一个编辑意图可能同时跨越其中多个位置。先前的系统按固定顺序查询独立的补全模型、邻近编辑模型和远距离编辑模型，每个模型各有自己的输出格式；因此它无法在单次响应中表达跨越远距离位置的编辑意图，每次建议可能需要多次顺序的模型调用，并且即使在修正方案更合适时也优先采用补全。我们提出了一个统一模型，在单一输出空间中预测所有三种编辑类型：一系列锚定差异补丁，指明位置、删除的行和新增的行。这种表示允许每次响应包含多个编辑，因此客户端可以从缓存中提供后续编辑……
tldr: 本文为GitHub Copilot提出统一行内代码编辑模型，通过锚定差异补丁的单一输出空间一次性预测光标补全、邻近编辑与远距离编辑三种类型，支持单次响应包含多个编辑，避免了原系统多次顺序调用不同模型的开销。
en_tdlr: A unified inline code editing model for GitHub Copilot that predicts completion, nearby edits, and long-distance edits in a single output space of anchored diff patches, enabling multiple edits per response and eliminating the need for sequential calls to separate models.
